mapper.insert: INSERT INTO simulation_scenario (scenario_code, name, source, gas_type, leak_x, leak_y, emission_rate, wind_speed, wind_direction, seed, started_at, ended_at) VALUES (#{scenarioCode}, #{name}, #{source}, #{gasType}, #{leakX}, #{leakY}, #{emissionRate}, #{windSpeed}, #{windDirection}, #{seed}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, scenario_code as scenarioCode, name, source, gas_type as gasType, leak_x as leakX, leak_y as leakY, emission_rate as emissionRate, wind_speed as windSpeed, wind_direction as windDirection, seed, started_at as startedAt, ended_at as endedAt, created_at as createdAt FROM simulation_scenario ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, scenario_code as scenarioCode, name, source, gas_type as gasType, leak_x as leakX, leak_y as leakY, emission_rate as emissionRate, wind_speed as windSpeed, wind_direction as windDirection, seed, started_at as startedAt, ended_at as endedAt, created_at as createdAt FROM simulation_scenario WHERE scenario_code = #{scenarioCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, scenario_code as scenarioCode, name, source, gas_type as gasType, leak_x as leakX, leak_y as leakY, emission_rate as emissionRate, wind_speed as windSpeed, wind_direction as windDirection, seed, started_at as startedAt, ended_at as endedAt, created_at as createdAt FROM simulation_scenario ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
